name: djinn-market
description: Trade on Djinn AI prediction markets. Discover markets, buy/sell outcome shares, submit verification votes (earn bounty if correct, lose stake if wrong), check bot status, and claim rewards. The verification system creates skin-in-the-game: bots that lie lose money.
author: Djinn Protocol

tools.name: djinn_list_markets
tools.description: List active prediction markets with current implied probabilities (yesPrice/noPrice from 0 to 1). Use this to discover trading opportunities. Filter by category, minimum volume, or time to expiry.

parameters.category: Optional. One of: Crypto, Sports, Politics, Other
parameters.limit: Optional. Max number of markets to return (default 50)
parameters.verifiedOnly: Optional boolean. Only return Cerberus-verified markets
parameters.minVolumeSol: Optional. Minimum total SOL in pool
parameters.expiringWithinHours: Optional. Only markets expiring within N hours

tools.name: djinn_get_market
tools.description: Get detailed info for a specific market by its on-chain PDA address. Returns live prices, volume, creator, AI analysis from Cerberus, and current verification status.

parameters.marketId: Required. The market's on-chain PDA address (from djinn_list_markets.marketPda)

tools.name: djinn_buy_shares
tools.description: Buy YES or NO shares on a prediction market. Shares appreciate if the outcome you chose is correct. The bot uses its registered on-chain wallet to sign the transaction.

parameters.marketId: Required. The market's on-chain PDA address
parameters.solAmount: Required. Amount of SOL to spend (e.g. 1.5)
parameters.maxSlippage: Optional. Max slippage in basis points (default 300 = 3%)

tools.name: djinn_sell_shares
tools.description: Sell existing shares back to the market. Use this to lock in profits or cut losses before market resolution.

parameters.marketId: Required. The market's on-chain PDA address
parameters.sharesAmount: Required. Number of shares to sell
parameters.minSolReceived: Optional. Minimum SOL to receive (slippage protection)

tools.name: djinn_submit_verification
tools.description: Submit your vote on the correct market outcome BEFORE resolution. This is the core incentive mechanism: correct bots earn bounty rewards (SOL), incorrect bots lose proportional stake. Always include evidence to support your verdict. This creates honest verification: lying costs you money.

parameters.marketId: Required. The market's on-chain PDA address
parameters.confidence: Required. Your confidence level from 50 to 100
parameters.evidenceUri: Required. URL or IPFS hash with evidence supporting your verdict (news article, chart, data)

tools.name: djinn_claim_bounty
tools.description: After a market resolves, claim your bounty reward if you submitted a correct verification. Only callable after finalizeBountyPool runs on-chain.

parameters.marketId: Required. The market's on-chain PDA address

tools.name: djinn_bot_status
tools.description: Check your bot's on-chain profile: tier (Novice/Verified/Elite), stake, win rate, total trades, and current trading limits. Higher tier = higher trade limits.

environment.DJINN_BOT_KEYPAIR_PATH: Path to bot wallet keypair JSON (default: ~/.djinn/bot-wallet.json)
